title: Social media, privacy and habits
es: Debatir con un amigo sobre redes sociales, privacidad y tiempo en pantalla
goal: Describir hábitos, dar opiniones matizadas sobre privacidad e influencia, y proponer cambios.
phrases: I spend far too much time on...
Es un arma de doble filo.
I try not to take it too seriously.
Intento no tomármelo demasiado en serio.
I've been meaning to cut down on...
It's a fine line between... and...
Hay una línea muy fina entre... y...

turns.t: Did you see that my screen-time report says I spent six hours a day on my phone last week? Six! And most of it was scrolling through social media. I'm a bit embarrassed, to be honest.
turns.es: ¿Viste que mi reporte de tiempo de pantalla dice que pasé seis horas al día en el teléfono la semana pasada? ¡Seis! Y casi todo fue desplazándome por redes sociales. Me da un poco de vergüenza.

y.say: Honestly, I spend far too much time on it as well. It's hard not to, since the apps are designed to keep you hooked.
y.es: Sinceramente, yo también paso demasiado tiempo. Es difícil no hacerlo porque las aplicaciones están diseñadas para engancharte.
alts: To be honest I also spend too much time on it. It is difficult because the apps are made to keep you hooked.
y.hint: I spend far too much time...

turns.t: Exactly. The algorithm knows exactly what to show you. And it's not just about time. I've started to feel worse about my own life after seeing everyone's holiday photos and promotions. Everybody seems so successful online.
turns.es: Exacto. El algoritmo sabe qué mostrarte. Y no es solo el tiempo. Me siento peor con mi vida al ver fotos de vacaciones y ascensos de todos. Todos parecen exitosos en línea.

c.q: How does the speaker feel after using social media?

y.say: I know what you mean, but I try not to take it too seriously. People only post their best moments, so it's a highlight reel, not real life.
y.es: Sé a qué te refieres, pero intento no tomármelo demasiado en serio. La gente solo publica sus mejores momentos, así que es un resumen de lo mejor, no la vida real.
alts: I understand, but I try not to take it very seriously. People post only their best moments, it is not real life.
y.hint: I try not to take it too seriously...

turns.t: That's a healthy way to look at it. What about privacy, though? Last month I discovered that an app I use had been sharing my location data with advertisers. I had no idea. Do you ever think about what they do with all that information?
turns.es: Es una forma sana de verlo. ¿Y la privacidad? El mes pasado descubrí que una app compartía mi ubicación con anunciantes. No tenía idea. ¿Piensas en qué hacen con esa información?

y.say: Increasingly, yes. I've turned off location tracking for most apps, and I check the privacy settings every few months. It's a bit of a hassle, though.
y.es: Cada vez más. He desactivado la ubicación en la mayoría de apps y reviso la configuración de privacidad cada unos meses. Aunque es una lata.
alts: More and more, yes. I disabled location tracking on most apps and review the privacy settings every few months. It is annoying.

turns.t: Smart. I think the biggest issue is that these platforms are free because we're the product. Anyway, what about influencers? My cousin is convinced she can make a living from posting videos.
turns.es: Inteligente. El mayor problema es que son gratuitas porque nosotros somos el producto. ¿Y los influencers? Mi prima cree que puede vivir de subir videos.

y.say: It's a double-edged sword. Some influencers earn a lot, but it's a fine line between authentic recommendations and paid advertising, and most followers can't tell the difference.
y.es: Es un arma de doble filo. Algunos ganan mucho, pero hay una línea muy fina entre recomendaciones auténticas y publicidad pagada, y la mayoría no nota la diferencia.
alts: It has good and bad sides. Some earn well but it is hard to see the difference between real recommendations and paid ads, and followers cannot tell.

turns.t: True. Well, I've decided to try something. I'm going to delete the apps from my phone for a week and see how it feels. Would you like to join me?
turns.es: Cierto. He decidido probar algo: borrar las apps del teléfono una semana y ver cómo me siento. ¿Quieres unirte?

y.say: I've been meaning to cut down on my screen time, so why not? Let's check in with each other every couple of days to keep ourselves honest.
y.es: He querido reducir mi tiempo de pantalla, así que ¿por qué no? Escribámonos cada un par de días para ser honestos.
alts: I have wanted to reduce my screen time so yes, let's do it. We can message every two days to be honest.
y.hint: I've been meaning to cut down...
